experimental_interpretation.release_question: Does a complete apparatus-level geometry reconstruction eliminate the V24.50 production geometry failures and produce coherent, inspectable sediment diagnostics in one release?

geometry_provenance.paper_conflict_note: Section 5.3 prose states 3 mm through / 10 mm depth; Fig.3, Fig.4 machining caption and Fig.6 state 4 mm through / 8 mm depth. V24.4 defaults to drawing/machining values.
geometry_provenance.photodiode_active_area_note: Not specified in the supplied paper; no invented active-area aperture is imposed.
geometry_provenance.source_launch_note: The paper defines the ring bore but does not locate the LED die/luminous plane within the module. V24.4 defaults the launch reference to the ring outer face and exposes it as a configurable parameter.
geometry_provenance.bottom_disc_note: Paper BOM/sample-cell description specifies a 3-mm clear acrylic disc glued to the tube bottom.
geometry_provenance.source_beta_note: Historical CLARITAS beam-divergence prior chosen manually in thesis section 5.2.3; used as a DGB audit prior, not treated as a measured LED datasheet law.
geometry_provenance.source_launch_audit_note: LED luminous plane is not dimensioned in the paper. Audit spans the 8-mm counterbore from its inner shoulder to the ring outer face.
geometry_provenance.tube_length_provenance: Kitchener et al., HardwareX 5 (2019) e00052, section 5.1: extruded acrylic tube 491 mm length; internal diameter 93 mm; external diameter 100 mm.
geometry_provenance.tube_inner_diameter_provenance: HardwareX section 5.1 gives 93 mm internal diameter; BOM stock is nominal 100/94 tube but machined/assembled cell description is authoritative for model geometry.
geometry_provenance.open_top_topology: open acrylic tube; bore/headspace is open to external air above the tube top; annular acrylic top face exists for Rin<=r<=Rout.

detector_estimator.selected_geometry: 4-mm diameter through-bore from r=50.5 to57.5 mm; 8.7-mm counterbore from57.5 to65.5 mm
detector_estimator.selected_score: 0.5*(native + mirrored) accepted bore paths; paths are separated into zero-wall-bounce direct and >=1-wall-bounce stray components
detector_estimator.legacy_comparison: original CLARITAS +/-6.5-degree boundary exit-position scorer; overlapping channels; not selected

particle_optics_v24_5.surface_reflectance: unpolarised Fresnel reflectance using complex n(d)+i*k(d)
particle_optics_v24_5.particle_encounter_cross_section: geometric pi*r^2 retained deliberately from V24.4 in this first attempt
particle_optics_v24_5.profile_status: exploratory hypothesis; not measured optical constants for these samples
particle_optics_v24_5.loess_profile_concept: fine fraction increasingly clay/iron-rich; coarse fraction increasingly quartz/feldspar-rich, mixed by complex Lorentz-Lorenz
particle_optics_v24_5.kaolin_profile_concept: conservative clay-dominant explicit profile; secondary to first loess diagnostic

apparatus_fix_v24_10_1.purpose: Correct the 622-nm steady-state DGB apparatus geometry before further sediment-physics changes.
new_cuda_physics: finite acrylic bottom-disc slab with repeated Fresnel/TIR
apparatus_fix_v24_10_1.dgb_constraint: Thesis Figure 4-3 water-only calibrated radiant-intensity ratio H10/H0 ~= 0.169807 from vector chart extraction.
apparatus_fix_v24_10_1.sediment_physics: Frozen from V24.10 during DGB audit.

apparatus_fix_v24_14.purpose: Test the thesis-documented stirred vortex as a fixed apparatus optical mechanism for the persistent 170-degree lobe.
new_cuda_physics: exact ray intersection with volume-preserving parabolic water-air free surface
water-air Fresnel reflection/TIR at local incidence angle
repeated reflected/TIR water-side encounters with curved surface
apparatus_fix_v24_14.headspace_scope: rays transmitted into air through the top are counted as top exits, retaining the established V24.10.1 treatment; air-headspace re-entry is outside this first diagnostic
apparatus_fix_v24_14.sediment_physics: Frozen reference morphology q=1, slope=25 deg, wave height=100 nm, isotropic; no population evolution.

apparatus_fix_v24_15.purpose: Replace the V24.14 full-radius rigid-body paraboloid with a localized, volume-preserving Scully-type vortex free surface motivated by the TARDIIS photograph.
new_cuda_physics: localized Scully-type free-surface height with independent core radius and wall-centre depth
exact rational-surface ray interception through a CUDA cubic solver
water-air Fresnel reflection/TIR at the local incidence angle
repeated reflected/TIR water-side encounters with the localized curved surface
apparatus_fix_v24_15.legacy_comparison: V24.14 parabolic_vortex remains selectable for A/B regression; delta_h=0 retains the exact historical flat branch.
apparatus_fix_v24_15.headspace_scope: rays transmitted into air through the top are counted as top exits; air-headspace re-entry remains outside this diagnostic
apparatus_fix_v24_15.sediment_physics: Frozen reference morphology q=1, slope=25 deg, wave height=100 nm, isotropic; nominal PSD/concentration; no aggregation, fragmentation, settling, or spatial concentration field.

sediment_transport_v24_16.purpose: Test whether size-dependent sediment redistribution generated by the continuously stirred Scully vortex can explain the remaining TARDIIS angular-response discrepancy without empirical optical multipliers.
sediment_transport_v24_16.mixing_closure: scalar effective eddy diffusivity D_t applied to radial and vertical particle transport
sediment_transport_v24_16.steady_field: zero-flux drift-diffusion with independent curved-vessel volume normalization for every PSD bin
sediment_transport_v24_16.optical_transport: CUDA Woodcock/delta tracking with exact per-bin density maxima and local event-bin sampling
sediment_transport_v24_16.mass_conservation: integrated number and mass of every PSD bin preserved; bulk concentration and bulk PSD unchanged
sediment_transport_v24_16.scope_limit: no finite-Re drag, explicit meridional CFD velocity field, wall resuspension/deposition kinetics, aggregation/fragmentation, sediment-flow feedback, or air-headspace re-entry
sediment_transport_v24_16.status: retained as legacy Stokes regression branch; V24.18 production validation uses the V24.17 finite-Re branch

sediment_transport_v24_17.purpose: Test whether the V24.16 improvement survives a physically stronger finite-Re drag treatment and better rear-channel convergence.
sediment_transport_v24_17.settling: Stokes terminal driving speed corrected implicitly with Schiller-Naumann drag
sediment_transport_v24_17.radial_slip: Stokes inertial driving speed tau_p*v_theta^2/r corrected pointwise with Schiller-Naumann drag
sediment_transport_v24_17.radial_potential: psi_i(r)=integral_R^r w_r,i(s)/D_t ds, tabulated on CUDA and interpolated in the ray kernel
sediment_transport_v24_17.mixing_closure: single scalar effective eddy diffusivity D_t applied to radial and vertical zero-flux transport
sediment_transport_v24_17.mass_conservation: each PSD bin independently normalised over the actual curved cell; bulk PSD is conserved
sediment_transport_v24_17.optical_transport: CUDA Woodcock/delta tracking with per-bin density majorants and local event-bin sampling
sediment_transport_v24_17.scope_limit: no explicit meridional CFD velocity field, nonspherical drag correlation, wall resuspension/deposition kinetics, aggregation/fragmentation, sediment-flow feedback, or air-headspace re-entry

validation_v24_18.purpose: Resolve whether the V24.17 finite-Re drift-diffusion improvement over uniform suspension survives substantially higher rear-channel statistics and stricter full-curve convergence.
validation_v24_18.selection_basis: V24.17 screening retained uniform plus finite-Re D_t = 0.00075, 0.001, 0.00125 and 0.002 m^2/s; D_t=0.0015 was omitted because it was not a concentration-wise or joint screening optimum.
validation_v24_18.decision_rule: Do not add new transport physics until these high-statistics cases determine whether the finite-Re redistribution effect is robust relative to the uniform control.
validation_v24_18.next_physics_if_not_sufficient: explicit secondary meridional/toroidal recirculation with mass-conserving particle advection-diffusion, not an empirical optical multiplier

sediment_transport_v24_19.circulation_parameter: chi=U_peak/max(v_theta), with max(v_theta)=Omega_c*a/2 for the localized Scully vortex
sediment_transport_v24_19.drag: Schiller-Naumann finite-Re correction retained for settling and centrifugal radial slip
sediment_transport_v24_19.solver: CUDA axisymmetric cell-centred finite volume, first-order upwind advection, centred diffusion, red-black SOR
sediment_transport_v24_19.boundaries: no-flux at bottom, axis, wall and curved free-surface active-mask boundary
sediment_transport_v24_19.mass_conservation: each PSD bin independently normalized to its prescribed bulk mean over the vessel volume
limitations: prescribed reduced circulation rather than CFD/PIV
no wall deposition or resuspension kinetics

collimator_stray_light_v24_20.ring_material_provenance: HardwareX paper states sensor ring was machined from waste nylon plastic.
collimator_stray_light_v24_20.absorbing_control: bitwise-intent regression of V24.19 hard aperture: any bore wall interception is loss
collimator_stray_light_v24_20.smooth_fresnel_nylon: exact smooth cylindrical/planar geometry; unpolarised Fresnel air-to-nylon reflection is traced; transmitted component is treated as lost in the thick ring
collimator_stray_light_v24_20.source_geometry: counterbore from source luminous plane to r=57.5 mm shoulder; 4-mm throat from r=57.5 to 50.5 mm
collimator_stray_light_v24_20.detector_geometry: 4-mm throat from r=50.5 to 57.5 mm; 8.7-mm counterbore from r=57.5 to 65.5 mm; detection at outer-plane proxy preserved because photodiode active plane is not dimensioned
scope_limits: no diffuse/subsurface nylon BRDF because surface albedo/roughness was not measured
no reflections from the broad inner cylindrical face of the sensor ring between bore openings
collimator_stray_light_v24_20.status: superseded for sediment interpretation by V24.21 due particle-optics confound; DGB-only evidence remains valid

particle_optics_v24_21.implementation: The package config contains the per-bin V24.5 n(d) arrays with k(d)=0, and the V24.21 production driver re-applies the same override after loading any config so complex k(d) cannot be re-enabled accidentally.
particle_optics_v24_21.complex_v24_5_status: available only as an explicit diagnostic particle-optics-mode; not used by the stray-light production sweep
particle_optics_v24_21.reason: V24.20 sediment stray-light results were confounded because the sweep omitted --real-index-only and silently reverted to exploratory complex n(d)+i k(d).

collimator_stray_light_v24_21.core_relation_to_v24_20: byte-identical core; only orchestration, baseline optics, gating and diagnostics are changed
collimator_stray_light_v24_21.safe_default: AA: absorbing source bore + absorbing detector bore

hypothesis_cases.AA: absorbing source / absorbing detector, regression control
hypothesis_cases.RR: smooth Fresnel source / smooth Fresnel detector

collimator_stray_light_v24_21.bore_material_model: unpolarised air/nylon Fresnel reflection with n=1.53; transmitted component is lost into thick nylon
collimator_stray_light_v24_21.regression_gate: AA at 0.5, 2 and 4 g/L must reproduce archived V24.18 uniform real-index-only reference curves/rates before reflective sediment cases proceed
collimator_stray_light_v24_21.conclusion: V24.21 clean regression rejected smooth specular bore-wall reflection as the H170 mechanism; AA absorbing bores retained.

inner_ring_face_stray_light_v24_22.question: Can specular stray-light paths from the broad inner cylindrical nylon face between collimator openings preferentially enhance H170 while preserving the independently calibrated DGB?
inner_ring_face_stray_light_v24_22.baseline: V24.21 AA / V24.18 high-stat uniform real-index-only optical baseline
inner_ring_face_stray_light_v24_22.ring_material: waste nylon plastic as documented for the sensor ring
inner_ring_face_stray_light_v24_22.cavity_physics: For rays rejected by the established direct detector acceptance, trace air->nylon Fresnel reflection at the ring inner cylinder, then air->acrylic Fresnel reflection at the tube outer cylinder. Repeated external-cavity bounces may subsequently enter an established detector bore.
inner_ring_face_stray_light_v24_22.aperture_handling: Any ray that enters a 4-mm detector or source throat but fails the complete absorbing-bore acceptance is lost in that bore and is not allowed to reflect from the broad face.
inner_ring_face_stray_light_v24_22.acrylic_transmission_boundary: Transmission from the external air gap back into acrylic terminates the apparatus-only cavity branch; it is not counted as ring-face stray light. This avoids misclassifying sample re-entry as direct apparatus stray light.
inner_ring_face_stray_light_v24_22.production_decision_rule: A reflective-face case is not admissible merely because sediment RMSE improves; it must also remain consistent with the independent DGB response.

detector_optics_v24_23.purpose: Test the actual TARDIIS SFH213 packaged-photodiode directional sensitivity after the validated hard collimator, while preserving the independent DGB source constraint.
detector_optics_v24_23.part: ams OSRAM SFH 213 silicon PIN photodiode
detector_optics_v24_23.datasheet_directional_fit: S(phi)=1/(1+(abs(phi)/10 deg)^p), p=ln(9)/ln(2)=3.169925..., anchored at S(10)=0.5 and approximately S(20)=0.1 from manufacturer directional plot
detector_optics_v24_23.weighting_interpretation: Each hard-collimator candidate photon contributes its package relative response as an analogue-equivalent Monte Carlo weight; no extra projected-area cosine factor is applied because the published directional characteristic is package-integrated.
detector_optics_v24_23.source_constraint: alpha2 remains 5.0; alpha1 is re-calibrated against the water-only DGB H10/H0 whenever the SFH213 response is enabled.
detector_optics_v24_23.baseline_model: ideal_hard_aperture with alpha1=0.45 must retain V24.21/V24.22 regression behavior.
detector_optics_v24_23.apparatus_surfaces: source bore, detector bore and inner ring face are fixed absorbing for this audit.
scope_limits: no invented epoxy refractive index or internal lens ray trace

particle_backreflectance_v24_24.purpose: Test projected-CSA/backreflectance hypothesis for both loess and kaolin without adding a fitted backscatter boost.
particle_backreflectance_v24_24.projected_CSA_definition: sum_i N_i*pi*(d_i/2)^2; units m^2 particle cross-section per m^3 suspension = m^-1.
particle_backreflectance_v24_24.reflective_CSA_reference: Projected CSA multiplied by water-to-mineral Fresnel reflectance; smooth-sphere reference only, not a fitted BRDF.
near_backscatter_diagnostics: smooth-sphere external Fresnel reflection at 170 deg
particle_backreflectance_v24_24.production_decision: No new particle-reflectance boost is accepted in V24.24.1; the release diagnoses whether/where the existing kernel fails.

event_history_v24_26.physics_baseline: V24.24.1 specular-microfacet hybrid_mie_excess, real-index-only n(d), k=0
event_history_v24_26.cuda_source_relation: byte-identical CUDA_SRC to V24.24.1; only host-side online decomposition is added
event_history_v24_26.interpretation_rule: No category is a fitted correction factor. Scores/fractions only diagnose the existing kernel.
event_history_v24_26.status: archived diagnostic baseline for V24.27 comparison

causal_last_event_v24_27.physics_baseline: V24.24.1 specular-microfacet hybrid_mie_excess, real-index-only n(d), k=0
new_diagnostics: first and last event deflection angle
first-event backscatter relative to incident direction
cumulative internal particle optical path n*L
water/suspension path after final particle event
causal_last_event_v24_27.causal_question: Does a genuine external surface reflection directly create H170, or do external reflections merely occur somewhere inside long multiple-scattering histories whose final event is another process?
causal_last_event_v24_27.absorption_readiness_note: Internal physical path and optical path are measured before any future k(d) absorption test; V24.27 itself retains k=0 and applies no absorption change.

exact_mie_event_rate_v24_29.physics_change: Only the event-rate cross-section is changed for Qsca<1 bins; per-event angular physics is V24.27 byte-for-byte in the relevant CUDA branch.
exact_mie_event_rate_v24_29.Qsca_ge_1_rule: Identical to V24.27: sigma_geom=pi*r^2 plus sigma_wave=(Qsca-1)*pi*r^2.
exact_mie_event_rate_v24_29.Qsca_lt_1_rule: No wave branch; geometric/interface event cross-section is thinned to Qsca*pi*r^2.
exact_mie_event_rate_v24_29.angular_kernel: V24.27 25-degree specular-microfacet geometric branch plus coherent-Mie/morphology-wave excess branch unchanged.
exact_mie_event_rate_v24_29.loess_regression_expectation: All production loess bins have Qsca>=1, so V24.29 should reproduce V24.27 with identical seeds to floating/RNG identity.
exact_mie_event_rate_v24_29.kaolin_test: Isolates the event-rate correction in bins that caused the V24.27 1.599297 legacy/exact event-rate ratio.

experiment: H170 full pre-turn angular-drift attribution; V24.29 exact-rate/V24.27 angular physics frozen

h170_final_turn_angular_state_v24_33.source_axis_angle_definition: 0 deg = +y/forward away from source; 90 deg = lateral boundary; 180 deg = -y/sourceward
h170_final_turn_angular_state_v24_33.primary_question: At high kaolin CSA, is the final forward-to-sourceward transition usually a large directional reversal, or a small event applied after the ray has already diffused close to 90 degrees?

v24_32_motivation.result_source: archived user-run V24.32 aggregate outputs packaged with this release

acrylic_topology_v24_52.external_air: outside connected acrylic/water/headspace body, including z>Zwall_top
acrylic_topology_v24_52.inner_wall_support: r=Rin for Zmin<=z<=Zwall_top; adjacent internal medium is water below local free surface and headspace above it
acrylic_topology_v24_52.bottom_sidewall_seam: z=Zmin, Rin<=r<=Rout, acrylic-acrylic, no optical event
acrylic_topology_v24_52.open_bore_top: z=Zwall_top, r<Rin, air-air continuation to external space; no Fresnel event
acrylic_topology_v24_52.watchdog_semantics: progress/runaway safety only; legacy max_cell_bounces=64 is not a scientific reflection limit

complete_geometry_v24_52.canonical_model: finite open acrylic tube plus bonded bottom disc, water/free-surface interior and air headspace

sediment_diagnostic_v24_52.h170_semantics: H170 is the 170-degree detector channel present in every canonical sediment case, not a separate material/concentration case.
